integrity: The general product inequality and the p=infinity equality were reconstructed directly from the chain definitions. The finite-p obstruction was proved by an exact transition analysis; a finite-state program independently checks representative instances but is not used as an infinite proof. The closest product-recurrence literature was inspected and does not imply the positive-threshold synchronization formula.
scientific_limitations: The exact amplification formula is for a concrete family of finite metric systems with the max product metric. The theorem does not classify all compatible product metrics, the negative-error non-gradient branch, or coarse Morse-graph products.
title: Finite-energy coarse recurrence has an unbounded product synchronization gap
